ar.title: موزة مطبوخة بالبطاطس الشيبس

steps.n1: قطّع اللحم مكعبات وقطّع البصل شرائح خشنة.
steps.n2: شوّح البصل في الزيت، وأضف اللحم وحمّره من جميع الجهات.
steps.n3: غطّه بماء دافئ، وتبّل، واطهه على نار هادئة جداً نحو ساعة.
steps.n4: قطّع البطاطس المقشرة أصابع رفيعة كأعواد الكبريت، واقلها حتى تصبح مقرمشة جداً، وصفّها على ورق ماص.
steps.n5: عندما ينضج اللحم، أضف البطاطس واطهها نحو 10 دقائق حتى تتشرب العصارة.

en.title: Braised Veal Shin with Straw Potatoes (Moza Matbukha)
en.intro: Recipe 238, page 106 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Cut the meat into bite-sized cubes and slice the onions coarsely.
steps.n2: Sauté the onions in oil, add the meat and brown it all over.
steps.n3: Cover with warm water, season and cook over a very low heat for about an hour.
steps.n4: Cut the peeled potatoes into matchsticks, fry until very crisp and drain on absorbent paper.
steps.n5: When the meat is ready, add the potatoes and cook for about 10 minutes so they soak up the juices.

legacySteps: Cut the meat into bite-sized cubes and slice the onions coarsely.
Sauté the onions in oil, add the meat and brown it all over.
Cover with warm water, season and cook over a very low heat for about an hour.
Cut the peeled potatoes into matchsticks, fry until very crisp and drain on absorbent paper.
When the meat is ready, add the potatoes and cook for about 10 minutes so they soak up the juices.
